requirements.text: Students should be able to look up books and check their availability in real time.
Students should be able to borrow and return items online.
Booking study rooms online needs to be an option.
Staff should have tools to manage book inventory, including adding and updating items.
There should be a system to track loans and fines effectively.
Reporting tools should be available to analyze popularity and borrowing trends.
Control over accounts must be available to manage fines and implement restrictions as needed.
There should be visibility into fines for students before borrowing.
Staff support must be available for clarifications when needed.
